output_md:
More coverage does not predict revenue; how fast deals clear stage two does.

1. Meridian Facilities Group saw a 18% reduction in overtime hours.
2. Their SLA compliance jumped from 87% to 96% in six months.
3. Dispatchers now use the Slatebridge board exclusively, abandoning whiteboards entirely.

Meridian’s ops director notes, "I used to spend my mornings untangling the schedule. Now I spend them on customers." For faster deal clearance, rethink coverage metrics and focus on pipeline velocity.
